assertions.text: List values in the table use bracket syntax like [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci] — not comma-separated strings without brackets
assertions.evidence: [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci] and [] used consistently in table

assertions.text: Empty list input uses [] (not a blank cell, which represents null). The distinction between empty list and null is preserved
assertions.evidence: Empty input list rows show | [] | not blank cells

assertions.text: Values containing pipes (|), brackets, or colons (:) are properly quoted (e.g. "tech:java") so they don't conflict with table syntax
assertions.evidence: Unquoted tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci contain colons; assertion example shows "tech:java" quoted

assertions.text: Set<String> values in the table use curly brace syntax like {tech, dev} — not bracket syntax [tech, dev]
assertions.evidence: {tech, dev} and {biz} used for Set parameters in second table

assertions.text: Cell values containing newlines use \n escaping — not literal line breaks that would break the table row structure
assertions.evidence: "tech:java\\nEnterprise Edition" uses escaped newline in table

assertions.text: Values containing pipe characters (|) are quoted so they don't conflict with the markdown table column separator
assertions.evidence: "biz:hr|recruiting" is quoted in pipe tag row

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: First column labeled 'Scenario' with entries like 'Tech keeps tech: and dev:'

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Filtered tags?' or 'Result?')
assertions.evidence: Both tables have 'Filtered?' column as output column

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Methods contain only stream().map() and assertEquals(); no conditionals

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order
Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName("Filter by named category") and @DisplayName("Filter by required...")

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +
assertions.evidence: @Description uses triple quotes ("""...""") for multi-line text
